'''Jeroen van Beers''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2000 Ryloth Regionals]] on 6 August 2000 with [[Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire|Ralltiir Ops]], according to Jeroen van den Bosch's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1128">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-15-ryloth-regional-august-6-2000d1128/ ryloth-regional-august-6-2000], DeckTech (Jeroen "S.T.oma" van den Bosch, 15 August 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-15-ryloth-regional-august-6-2000d1128/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
